paragraphs: Gias Foods is recalling bettergoods Authentic Italian Lemon Alfredo Fettuccine sold at Walmart nationwide due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination, which can cause serious and sometimes fatal infections in young children, frail or elderly people, and others [5][18]. GF Blends is recalling Truly AIP All Purpose Flour and Bread Mix and EAT G.A.N.G.S.T.E.R. Flat Bread Pizza Mix because they may contain undeclared wheat gluten [1]. Saratoga Potato Chips is recalling two best-if-used-by codes of 7.75-ounce packages of J. HIGGS Loaded Bacon and Cheddar Potato Chips due to potential undeclared soy allergen [3].

Additional recalls include So Delicious Dairy Free Salted Caramel Cluster Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert pints with best-by dates on and before April 3, 2028 due to potential foreign materials [4]. A&P Creations LLC has issued a nationwide recall of biQ-FEL because it contains undeclared Sildenafil and Tadalafil, active ingredients in prescription drugs Viagra and Cialis [7].
